notes: Part 4 adds reusable typography components on the shared timeline. Paragraph wrapping and parameter checks pass without Cairo. build() still needs Manim Text. Preview renders remain untested here.

components.name: QUONITRON Dark Theme
components.description: Default premium dark editorial theme: semantic colors, type hierarchy, spacing, stroke, and motion tokens.
use_cases: Apply a consistent look to every educational scene
Override accent colors without changing component APIs
components.example:
from quonitron_manim.design import get_theme
theme = get_theme()
bg = theme.color('background')
components.limitations: Does not render pixels. Font names are fallbacks; glyph metrics vary by OS.

components.name: QUONITRON Base Scene
components.description: Manim Scene subclass that applies the theme, safe areas, and title/caption helpers.
use_cases: Start every explainer scene from a consistent shell
Place titles and on-screen captions inside the safe frame

theme_name.description: Registered theme to apply in setup()

components.limitations: Requires a working Manim Cairo renderer to construct real Text mobjects. Do not override __init__; use setup().

components.name: Title Card
components.description: Centered branded title with a kicker label and a thin accent rule.
use_cases: Opening title of an educational video
Chapter cards between sections

kicker.description: Small uppercase label above the rule

components.limitations: Needs Pango/Cairo to build Text. Long titles are not auto-wrapped.

components.name: Section Heading
components.description: In-scene heading with a vertical accent marker.
use_cases: Introduce a new beat inside a scene
Label a diagram
components.limitations: Single-line heading. Does not paginate long strings.

components.name: Variable Store
components.description: Rounded card showing a variable name and a replaceable stored value.
use_cases: Explain how a variable stores a value
Show assignment as a value replacement

variable_name.description: Identifier drawn at the top of the card

components.limitations: Value replacement is a Transform of a Text mobject, not a live Python interpreter.

components.name: Subtitle Track
components.description: Subtitle-first cue model with validation and SRT/WebVTT export. Timings are estimates until aligned to real voiceover.
use_cases: Author English explainer captions without audio
Export SRT/VTT for later human voiceover alignment

reading_wpm.description: Estimated reading speed in words per minute

components.limitations: Does not transcribe audio or generate voice. Estimated times are not a real speaker.

components.name: Shared Scene Timeline
components.description: One seconds timeline for visual events and subtitle cues. Optional beats are conceptual chapters on the same clock; a scene change does not start a second timer.
use_cases: Keep captions and animations on the same clock
Carry a sentence across a conceptual scene change
Override cue times after recording voiceover without rewriting animation code

frame_rate.description: Used only to convert seconds to frames

components.limitations: Playback adapter sequences play() calls; overlapping play windows must set overlap_ok. Beats are labels, not a second clock.

components.name: Subtitle Overlay
components.description: Bottom-safe caption mobject updated from Timeline.cue_at() on the shared clock.
use_cases: Render the same cues that are exported to SRT/VTT across beat boundaries
components.limitations: Needs Pango/Cairo to build Text. Updater uses dt from play/wait.

components.name: Narration Segmenter
components.description: Split a full English narration into readable cues with configurable limits and estimated durations.
use_cases: Author many subtitle cues from one paragraph of explanation
components.limitations: Does not call TTS or transcription. Durations are estimates.

components.name: QUONITRON Moving Camera Scene
components.description: QuonitronMovingCameraScene subclasses manim.MovingCameraScene so camera.frame can pan and zoom. Plain QuonitronScene cannot.
use_cases: Zoom into a memory cell, then restore the full diagram
components.limitations: camera.frame is a MovingCamera API. Unit tests do not render a zoom.

components.name: Plain Text Wrap
components.description: Word-wrap a string to a character budget without importing Manim.
use_cases: Plan paragraph breaks before constructing Text mobjects
components.limitations: Character budget is a heuristic, not a glyph-width measure.

components.name: Fade In
components.description: Fade a mobject in, optionally shifting from a direction.
use_cases: Bring a diagram into the scene without drawing its path

run_time.description: Duration in seconds. Overrides speed when set.

speed.description: Theme motion token used when run_time is omitted

easing.description: Rate-function alias from the design system

shift.description: Optional direction name: UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT

components.example:
from quonitron_manim.motion.appearance import FadeInMotion
anim = FadeInMotion(run_time=0.6).animate(mob)
components.limitations: Requires Manim Community Edition to build the Animation. Unit tests cover parameter validation only.
